第十三章流沙无形（第一卷完）
沙之心宫的地面开始蠕动。
不是地震，而是整座宫殿的黑色晶石在软化、液化，化作粘稠的流沙。江流云撑起的隐流防护阵发出刺耳的“滋滋”声，阵法光幕以肉眼可见的速度被沙化侵蚀。
“师父！”霓漪惊呼，她的一条手臂不慎伸出阵外，瞬间就被流沙覆盖。那沙不是普通的沙，而是带着腐蚀灵力的恶沙，霓漪的手臂以肉眼可见的速度干枯、沙化。
江眼疾手快，隐流之力爆发，一道白光斩断那片流沙，同时将霓漪拉回阵内。断臂处没有流血，而是露出了灰白色的骨质——沙化已深入骨髓。
“不要接触这些沙子！”江流云厉喝，额头渗出冷汗。他的本命水精石正在急速消耗，防护阵最多还能撑半柱香。
宫殿中央，那个由流沙凝聚的人形——沙魔缓缓“走”来。它的步伐很怪，不是迈步，而是整个下半身如沙漏般流动前移。
“本座'漠千骸’。”沙魔发出沙哑的共鸣声，仿佛千万粒沙子同时震动，“三百年来，共有一百七十四位修行者葬身此宫。你们的灵力...很特别，尤其是那条小蛟。”
它的“目光”落在霓影身上：“血灵蛟...罕见。你的血雷之力，或可助我突破第九重沙化之境。”
霓影怒极反笑：“那就看你有没有这个本事！”
她化身小血蛟真身，张口喷出血色雷电，电光所过之处，黑色晶石宫殿被劈出道道裂痕，但沙魔漠千骸只是散成流沙，避开雷击，又在另一处重组。
“没用的。”漠千骸的声音从四面八方传来，“在这沙之心宫，我即是沙，沙即是我。你们所有的攻击，不过是徒劳。”
它抬手，整座宫殿的流沙突然沸腾，化作无数沙蛇扑向防护阵。阵法光幕剧烈震荡，裂纹如蛛网蔓延。
江流云大汗淋漓，阵法濒临崩溃。他心一横准备使出燃烧修为的搏命技：燃血隐魂阵，虽然可能重伤，但总比被擒好。江双手结印，头上冒出巨大的光华，感受到江的威压，漠千骸那模糊的脸居然也紧张的扭曲起来。
就在此时——
“时空·凝。”
一个清冷的女声响起。
声音很轻，却仿佛带着某种法则之力。刹那间，沸腾的流沙、扑来的沙蛇、甚至空气中扬起的沙尘，全部静止。
不是被冰封，也不是被石化，而是纯粹的“静止”。时间在这一小片空间内，停止了流动。

一位白衣女子从虚空中走出。
她赤足踏在静止的沙面上，每一步都泛起淡淡的空间涟漪。女子蒙着面纱，只露出一双清澈如寒潭的眼眸，眼角有颗小小的泪痣。身姿纤细却挺拔，白衣胜雪，天鹅的颈项。她走到近前，除下面纱，朱唇轻启露出颗娇俏的虎牙，在昏暗的地宫中宛如星光凝聚。
她走到防护阵前，抬手轻触即将破碎的光幕。指尖所触之处，阵法裂纹竟开始倒流愈合！
“江流云，多年不见。”女子的声音中带着一丝若有若无的笑意。
江流云望着眼前的女子定定的看了许久，竟似连呼吸都已凝滞··“轻烟，沈轻烟”
白衣女子——沈轻烟微微颔首，转身面对被静止的漠千骸。她取出一颗拳头大小的透明晶石，晶石内部有星河般的光点流转。
“空间凝结精石只能维持三十息。”她语速极快，“走！”
说罢，她单手结印，晶石精光大盛，静止的空间被撕开一道巨大的裂缝。沈轻烟一手拉住江流云，另一手挥袖将霓影五人卷起，闪入裂缝。
三十息到，空间恢复流动。
漠千骸的沙蛇扑了个空，它发出震怒的嘶吼，整座沙之心宫开始崩塌。
---
沙漠边缘，一片绿洲水潭旁。
七人从空间裂缝中跌出。江流云第一时间检查霓漪的伤势，发现沙化已蔓延到肩膀，必须立刻截肢。
“我来。”沈轻烟走到霓漪身前，取出三根银针，精准刺入霓漪肩部穴位。沙化竟真的停止了蔓延。
“暂时压制，但需沙漠灵力才能根治。”她收起银针，看向江流云，“说说吧，怎么惹上漠千骸的？”
江流云苦笑：“本想带孩子们来沙漠历练，感应到空间异常便探查，不料...”
“中了陷阱。”沈轻烟接话，“漠千骸最擅空间幻术，那沙之心宫本就是它制造的诱饵。”
江痴痴的望向轻烟，那是一张多么令人屏息的脸。五官精致如工笔画，皮肤白皙近乎透明，最动人的是那双眼睛——清澈中带着历经沧桑的淡然，又蕴含着迷离的情愫。虽看上去不过二十七八，但江流云知道，她与自己同龄，都已过不惑之年。
十年未见，她依旧如当年那个在江南烟雨中撑伞而立的等待他的女子，只是眉眼间多了几分疏离与坚韧。
“你...”江流云千言万语堵在胸口。

沈轻烟却已转身：“先救你的兄弟。”
她掌心浮现出一幅灵力地图：“杨思纯四人在半路上已陷入漠千骸的‘九影沙阵’。此阵有九个分身，每个分身都有本体七成实力。最可怕的是，杀死一个分身，漠千骸可将其他分身的武力值瞬间拉满，且能无限重生。这些年，不少高手都是耗尽灵力而亡。”

Chapter Thirteen: Quicksand Invisible (End of Volume 1)
The ground in the Heart of Sand Palace began to squirm.
It wasn't an earthquake, but the black crystal stones throughout the palace were softening and liquefying, turning into sticky quicksand. The hidden current protective array held up by Jiang Liuyun made a harsh "sizzling" sound, and the formation's light curtain was eroded by sand at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Master!" Niyi exclaimed. One of her arms accidentally stretched out of the formation and was instantly covered by quicksand. The sand was not ordinary sand, but evil sand with corrosive spiritual power. Niyi's arms dried up and turned into sand at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Jiang Yan has quick hands, and the power of the hidden current explodes. A white light cuts off the quicksand, and at the same time pulls Niyi back into the formation. There was no blood on the broken arm, but gray-white bone was exposed - the sand had penetrated deep into the bone marrow.
"Don't touch this sand!" Jiang Liuyun shouted, cold sweat breaking out on his forehead. His natal water essence stone is being consumed rapidly, and the protective array can still hold up half a stick of incense at most.
In the center of the palace, the human figure condensed from quicksand - the Sand Demon "walked" slowly. Its pace is strange. It's not a step, but the entire lower body moves forward like an hourglass.
"This is the 'Mo Qian Shi'." The sand demon made a hoarse resonant sound, as if thousands of grains of sand were vibrating at the same time. "Over the past three hundred years, a total of 174 practitioners have been buried in this palace. Your spiritual power... is very special, especially that little dragon."
Its "eyes" fell on Ni Ying: "The blood spirit dragon... is rare. Your power of blood thunder may help me break through the ninth level of sand transformation."
Ni Ying laughed angrily: "Then let's see if you have the ability!"
She transformed into the true form of a little blood dragon and opened her mouth to spit out blood-colored thunder and lightning. Wherever the lightning passed, the black spar palace was split into cracks, but the desert corpses of the Sand Demon just scattered into quicksand, avoiding the lightning strike, and reorganized in another place.
"It's useless." Mo Qiankui's voice came from all directions, "In this Heart of Sand Palace, I am the sand, and the sand is me. All your attacks are in vain."
It raised its hand, and the quicksand in the entire palace suddenly boiled, turning into countless sand snakes and rushing towards the protective formation. The array light curtain vibrated violently, and cracks spread like spider webs.
Jiang Liuyun was sweating profusely, and his formation was on the verge of collapse. He was ready to use the life-threatening skill that burns his cultivation: the Burning Blood Hidden Soul Formation. Although he might be seriously injured, it was better than being captured. Jiang formed a seal with his hands, and a huge light emerged from his head. Feeling Jiang's pressure, Mo Qianhui's blurry face actually became nervous and twisted.
At this moment——
"Time and Space Condensation."
A cold female voice sounded.
The voice was very soft, but it seemed to carry the power of some kind of law. In an instant, the boiling quicksand, the rushing sand snakes, and even the dust rising in the air all stopped.
Not frozen, nor petrified, but pure "stillness". Time stopped flowing in this small space.
A woman in white walked out of the void.
She stepped barefoot on the still sand, and there were faint ripples in space with every step. The woman was covered with a veil, revealing only a pair of eyes as clear as cold pools, with a small tear mole in the corner of her eyes. The figure is slender but upright, the white clothes are whiter than the snow, and the neck is like a swan. She walked closer, took off her veil, and opened her red lips to reveal a delicate tiger tooth, which looked like starlight in the dim underground palace.
She walked to the protective formation and raised her hand to touch the light curtain that was about to break. Wherever the fingertips touched, the cracks in the formation began to flow back and heal!
"Jiang Liuyun, long time no see." There was a hint of smile in the woman's voice.
Jiang Liuyun stared at the woman in front of him for a long time, as if even his breathing had stopped... "Light smoke, heavy smoke"
The woman in white, Shen Qingyan, nodded slightly and turned to face the still Mo Qiangui. She took out a fist-sized transparent crystal. There were stars of light flowing inside the crystal.
"The space condensed essence stone can only last for thirty breaths." She spoke very fast, "Let's go!"
Having said that, she used one handThe seal was formed, the crystal light was in full bloom, and a huge crack was torn open in the still space. Shen Qingyan held Jiang Liuyun with one hand and waved her sleeves with the other hand to roll up the five Niying people and duck into the crack.
When thirty breaths are up, the space resumes its flow.
Mo Qianshui's sand snake flew into the air, it roared in rage, and the entire Heart of Sand Palace began to collapse.
---
On the edge of the desert, next to an oasis pool.
Seven people fell out of the crack in space. Jiang Liuyun immediately checked Niyi's injury and found that the desertification had spread to his shoulder, and the leg had to be amputated immediately.
"I'll do it." Shen Qingyan walked up to Niyi, took out three silver needles, and accurately inserted them into the acupuncture points on Niyi's shoulders. The desertification actually stopped spreading.
"Suppress it for the time being, but it requires desert spiritual power to cure it." She put away the silver needle and looked at Jiang Liuyun, "Tell me, how did you get Mo Qiangui into trouble?"
Jiang Liuyun smiled bitterly: "I wanted to take the children to the desert to experience it. I sensed an abnormality in the space and investigated it, but unexpectedly..."
"Fell into a trap." Shen Qingyan answered, "Mo Qiankui is the best at space illusion, and the Sand Heart Palace was originally the bait created by him."
Jiang looked at Qing Yan infatuatedly, what a breathtaking face that was. The facial features are as delicate as a meticulous painting, the skin is fair and almost transparent, and the most touching thing is the eyes - clear with the indifference that has gone through vicissitudes of life, but also contains blurred emotions. Although she looks no more than twenty-seven years old, Jiang Liuyun knows that she is the same age as him and has already passed her forties.
After not seeing each other for ten years, she was still the same woman who stood with an umbrella in the misty rain in the south of the Yangtze River, waiting for him, but there was a bit more alienation and tenacity between her eyebrows.
"You..." Jiang Liuyun had thousands of words stuck in his chest.
However, Shen Qingyan turned around: "Save your brother first."
A spiritual power map appeared in the palm of her hand: "Yang Sichun and the four of them have fallen into Mo Qiankui's 'Nine Shadows Sand Formation' halfway. There are nine clones in this formation, and each clone has 70% of the strength of the original body. The most terrifying thing is that by killing one clone, Mo Qiankui can instantly increase the force value of other clones, and can be reborn infinitely. In recent years, many masters have exhausted their spiritual power and died."
